systems.system: digital transformation plan (Trans-Saharan Fibre Optic Dorsal project)
systems.owner: Government of Niger; financed by the African Development Bank
systems.tiers: Described as launched by the government as part of the AfDB-financed Trans-Saharan Fibre Optic Dorsal project, and as consisting of providing a data centre to government and private stakeholders; no date for the launch.

note: An environmental impact study for the national data centre; the 'digital transformation plan' is described only as the data-centre component of a financed project, so it is a programme with no dated fact.
